title: Creamy Palak Paneer
description: A classic North Indian dish made with spinach and paneer in a rich and creamy sauce. Serve over naan or basmati rice for a delicious meal.

ingredients.name: Paneer
ingredients.notes: Make sure to squeeze out as much water as possible from the spinach

ingredients.name: Garlic
ingredients.notes: Mince the garlic and sauté it before adding the spinach

instructions: Heat oil in a pan and sauté the onions until they are translucent.
Add the ginger and garlic and sauté for another minute.
Add the spinach and cook until it has wilted.
Add the paneer, cumin powder, red chili powder, salt, and kasoori methi. Mix well.
Add the heavy cream and mix until the sauce thickens.
Serve hot with naan or basmati rice.
